construction: Study 0009 remains intact. Study 0010 holds its final state as an inspectable room instrument: entered-room lines, frontier sides, the inherited red path, the complete 64-room scaffold, six fixed views, automatic rotation, and unrestricted manual orbit can each be inspected without changing the geometry.
invariants: the inherited 64-state path and final entered-room set
the Study 0009 open-edge and frontier-face rules
all toggles change visibility or shader contribution only
all six quick views and manual orbit change only the camera

controls.lines: show or hide the final frontier-safe entered-room edges
controls.sides: show or hide the final transparent frontier faces
controls.red_line: show or hide the complete inherited 64-state path
controls.red_dot: show or hide the smaller Study 0009 point at the final inherited path position
controls.views: front, back, left, right, top, and bottom
controls.rotate: turn automatic camera rotation on or off
controls.scaffold: show or hide all 300 unit edges belonging to the complete 4 by 4 by 4 room field; the ghost line remains visibly subordinate but present
controls.unconnected_points: show or hide lattice points whose neighboring rooms are all unselected, so none of those points touches an entered room
controls.orbit: drag freely through a full 360-degree inspection
